caption: Kar. 47. Stela (Kar. Cem., Pl. 19, No. 7103)
reading: qo : ḫwitrorqo : peseto : aki(2)ñtelo : nk : akiñtelo : ḫrpḫñ (3)pẖrsetelo : lẖsmlowoto : tb(4)qo : tmñtelo : qoredeklo : a(5)moke : nlotilo : mlomrse : (6)akiñtelo : womnitẖ : a(7)kiñtelo : ant : boqḫw : di(8)k : pedemeyotito : pqr : qori(9)se : atmetñ : tbo : yetmdelo : sotn(10)kel : yetmdelo : tbḫemḫr : yetm(11)delo : litḫror : yetmdelo : kdi : a(12)kw : knw : ḫtekkesdestel : mteto (13)qoresemle : dewekdil : mteto : arwt(14)l : mteto : mlolo : tebwe : wwikelo :
notes: Read right to left, words written left to right. Line 1 carries no number; the first group 'qo' (3-sign with slash on its left + one slash) stands before the first divider, so the top of the text may be lost. Convention used: the hooked 3 with a slash immediately to its left (display '/3') is read q (so '//3' = qo, as in 'pqr'); hooked 3 alone = ẖ; plain 3 = m (it is m in the repeated 'yetmdelo'), but the plain 3s in line 4 'lẖ?m?s?lowoto' and in 'wosn?ii?ts?', 'ḫtekkemdemtel', 'qorl?sem?le', 'mteto', 's?lolo' could each be m, s or ẖ. 3 with a long tail = k (as in akiñte, kdi); Σ-topped sign with long tail = p (peseto, ḫrpḫñ, pqr, pedemeytito); the λ/ʎ sign = d (Griffith's Kar column shows d this way; it gives yetmde, kdi). Small ϟ before / is read l in the many '-lo' endings; S vs ϟ (e vs l) is uncertain throughout. 'ḫrpḫñ' and '(3)pm?rsetelo' are separated by a clear gap without divider; the sign read m? there is a ℸ/) shape. 'tr?(4)qo': the sign read r? is a thick ω-like shape (could be b). 'ẖ?boredeklo' and 'tbo?': the b is a ν with a slash at its left, read b + o. 'nk' (n + long-tailed 3) is short and odd. 'wosn?ii?ts?': the sign read n? is hatched (damaged); the next two signs look like two 4s, the second crossed by the n's stroke. 'di(8)k?': last sign is a lone 2 with long tail (k or n). 'qtn(10)ae': first sign is a 3 with a slash at its left. 'boqḫw': or boẖoḫw if the slash is o. Line 1 'ḫwitror' and line 10 'litḫror' share -tror/-ḫror. 'n?nw': first sign ʌ with long tail. 'ḫtekkemdemtel': two long-tailed 3s in a row. 'mteto' at the end of the row before (13) has no divider after it; a space is written. 'de?wekdii?l': first sign S + ʎ, could also be a (S2 shape); two 4-like signs after kd. Row 13: after 'te' one hatched sign partly visible and hatching about one sign wide, written [.][.]. 's?lolo': a stray dot between the 3 and the l.
check_notes: All Kar. 47 entries placed. The index forms show this copy writes the hooked 3 as q when a slash stands at its left (qo, pqr, qoredeklo, qoresemle) but as m or ẖ elsewhere, the closed 3 as s (sotnkel, ḫtekkesdestel), and i sometimes as a doubled 4. A step-1 error from overlapping crops (al(5)moke) was found and corrected. Copy keeps yetmdelo four times where Index A/B print one or more as yetmdelowi. The opening 'qo :' is the 'qo introducing name' of Index C.

caption: Kar. 48. Stela (?)
reading: wos?i : q?[.][.][.][.][.]i?i? : (2)sdeñyoliqowi : (3)yiteli dḫelosi (4)tmes : ḫide : teori(5)kelowi : at : mḫe : pi(6)sid?o?kte : at?to : mḫe : pi(7)siẖte
notes: Stone crossed by a dotted crack line; groups separated by gaps at the crack are written with one space. Line 1: wos?i, the 3 is hatched on its right side but readable; the divider after it is a single dot. After it a 3 with a slash (q?) and then a run of about fourteen broken bold strokes (about five sign widths, written [.]x5) ending in two 4-like signs (i? i?) and two dot-and-stroke marks read as a divider. '(2)ẖdeñyliqowi': first sign hooked 3 without slash (ẖ), then ʎ (d), S, crossed ñ, four strokes (y). '(3)yiteli': the y is two strokes only. 'd?ḫeteẖ?i': first sign crossed-with-loop, d or ñ; the hooked sign before the final 4 overlaps it. 'ḫib?l?': b? is a ν with slash; the last sign has dots/hatching above it. Line 3 holds the two benedictions: 'at : mḫe : pi(6)sin?r?kte' and 'at?to : mḫe : pi(7)siḫ?te'. In the first, after pisi come an ʌ with a hook (n?) and a small T-shaped sign (r?), then k and te; in the second a plain 3 (ḫ? or m) stands there. The t in 'at?to' is hatched (damaged). After 'kte' a dot and a short stroke before the gap, read as a divider. The text ends without a divider.
check_notes: All entries placed except two Index C entries that do not refer to Kar. 48. The formulae run B then A, as Griffith notes on p. 43. Formula B's queried d? o? are kept with Griffith's queries. Line 1 after wos?i (q? and the broken strokes) and teori(5)kelowi are not covered by any entry and stay as in step 1.
